revisions.evidence: source "inflict %0.2f mind damage (range 10), gaining psi and hate equal to 10%%%% of the damage done" ↔ target "造成%0.2f精神伤害（距离10），获得相当于造成伤害10%%%%的灵能值和仇恨值"：单占位符、距离 10、10%% 比例与灵能/仇恨双资源均保留
source "explode against your foes for %d cold damage (based on your Magic)" ↔ target "造成%d寒冷伤害（基于魔法）"：自爆行为、伤害类型与加成属性一致

两个 %0.2f 顺序对应 "temporal damage"/"physical damage" → "时空伤害和 %0.2f 物理伤害"；"(<20%%)" → "不足 20%%"；"50%% additional damage to targets affected by temporal destabilization and/or continuum destabilization" → "对受时空紊乱和/或连续紊乱的目标会多造成 50%%的伤害" 条件完整
